Відомості про транспортні засоби, які обслуговують пасажирські автобусні, та трамвайні маршрути перевезення (марка, модель, державний номер, пасажиромісткість). Coverage: Кам'янська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Кам'янська міська рада. Its keywords include авто, міський, трамвай, транспорт. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua.
